Questions

What is the median annual wage for Police officers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Police and Sheriff's Patrol Officers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $107,810.

What is the hourly median for Police officers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Police and Sheriff's Patrol Officers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $51.83.

How many Police officers work in Chicago?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 22,680 wage-and-salary Police and Sheriff's Patrol Officers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Police officers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 1.17. Values above 1.00 mean Police and Sheriff's Patrol Officers are more concentrated in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Police officers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Police and Sheriff's Patrol Officers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $99,230.

How does Chicago's Police officers median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Chicago's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($107,810) is $25,520 higher than Austin ($82,290) and $7,310 lower than Seattle ($115,120). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
